name: Mimikatz LSASS Access
description: Mimikatz opens a handle to lsass.exe with PROCESS_VM_READ | PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION (GrantedAccess 0x1010) to dump credential material from memory. Sysmon Event ID 10 (ProcessAccess). Source process is an unsigned binary in a user-writable temp path, so none of the rule's AV/system/backup exclusions apply. Must fire the LSASS memory access rule.
